age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from Solana

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Lowest context slot of the finalized reads behind the answer

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

block_time.description: Block time of that slot; null when there is no transaction or it is unavailable

excess.description: Received minus expected when `paid`, in the units of `received.ui`; null otherwise

expected.description: The amount the request asked to confirm

raw.description: Expected amount in raw base units (lamports for SOL); null when the mint does not appear in the transaction's token balances, so its decimals are unknown

ui.description: Expected amount in UI units, as the request asked to confirm it

raw.description: What the recipient received in raw base units, net of a Token-2022 transfer fee; a closed token account counts its whole balance as a negative delta

ui.description: The same amount in UI units; null when the mint's decimals are unknown

received.description: What the recipient received; null when there is no transaction to read

slot.description: Slot holding the transaction; null when there is no transaction

flag.description: Which side is assumed at par: the USD peg (`assumed_parity`) or the EUR peg

fx_rate_date.description: Date of the ECB reference rate used, the latest on or before the payment's date

note.description: That the value is an informative reference, not a tax figure

value_eur.description: Received value in EUR, a decimal string

value_usd.description: Received value in USD, a decimal string

verdict.description: The first verdict that matches, in the documented order

description: Did this settled Solana payment deliver the expected amount to the expected recipient? When to use: After a payment has been submitted: to confirm from the chain that the recipient received the mint and amount you expected, including the Token-2022 fee case. Prefer another tool: Before sending a transfer (use `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness`), or to list a wallet's transfers or balances (none are returned). Example: solana_payment_verify {"signature":"B7yABUkY4RudiDfoax94mfqVv2YuNJ4AVsg7LjdFT9Qm8bScsw3PoB2LxpuUqzCkiniKQJ9AKXfSfWaw1kWYFaF","recipient":"GEJySUi6LjHwQWKD2BDg3TiGKwhKmBU7JJTjZfk1RD54","mint":"SOL","amount":"0.02"} Paid: 0.01452 USDC or 0.0121 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.0025 EUR-denominated units (approx 400 calls per bundle) or 0.003 USD-denominated units (approx 273 calls per bundle).

amount.description: Positive decimal amount the payment had to deliver, in UI units (not lamports or raw units); at most 9 decimals for SOL

mint.description: `SOL` for native SOL, or the mint address of the SPL Token or Token-2022 token the payment had to deliver

recipient.description: Wallet the payment had to reach (not its token account): Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

reference.description: Reference key the payment had to carry among its account keys: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes; omit to skip the reference check

signature.description: Transaction signature of the payment to verify: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 64 bytes

source.description: Wallet the payment had to be signed by: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes; omit to skip the sender check

name: solana_payment_verify
title: Solana payment verify
